improved.text: Podium and table numbers roll smoothly when you switch category or filters.
Ctrl+K shows teams first, with an exact tag match at the top.
long alert messages wrap on phones and keep their line breaks.
links in alerts open safely, and links to DEAFCS stay in the app.

fixed.text: Large pages (100 players) no longer lag when switching category.
T and CT stats such as ADR now count every round played on that side, not only rounds with a kill or death.
Connect on a public server now joins it instead of only opening CS2.
a party can only queue when every member meets the queue's role requirement.
a system alert you dismissed shows again when staff put it back up.

improved.text: Player of the Month, Last 7 Days and the selected player now sit in a sidebar on the right, and the board keeps its full width.
A selected player's rank on every board shows right away, without an extra click.
The Role filter is gone from leaderboards; roles still show on profiles and match pages.
A player's rank on every board shows almost at once, and the rank bars grow in when they load.
Switching between players in the side panel now animates smoothly.
Changing your region between EU and SA now asks you to confirm first.
Pages with many stats, like match pages and the leaderboard, open faster.
Match pages load their round history faster.
Switching between categories is smooth, without the board blanking or loading twice.

fixed.text: A season whose medals were awarded keeps its dates, and a season with rated matches can't be deleted by mistake.
A player's rank on every board now follows the Min. matches filter, so it matches the leaderboard.
Tied players now show the same rank in the side panel as on the leaderboard.
In a best-of-3 or best-of-5, picking a map in a player's stats now shows that map's numbers instead of the whole series.
In a best-of-3 or best-of-5, the Utility tab now shows the map you picked.
Buy types now use the money a team started the round with.

new.text: Watch lists live main broadcasts first, with both teams.

improved.text: Extra stream links are now buttons with the platform icon in the match bar.
Players and coaches can watch their match's delayed TV broadcast and Twitch main broadcast.
Watch now updates matches, streams and viewer counts by itself, no refresh needed.
Player Twitch streams now show as POV links in the match bar, and the big video area is only used for the official broadcast.

fixed.text: The GOTV delay can no longer be changed by non-admins while a match is running.
The live stream scoreboard shows workshop maps by their name, such as Mini Dust 2, instead of a number.
Connect on Public Servers now opens CS2 straight away, without the connection guide.
Connect on Public Servers now only opens CS2; copying the address stays on the Copy button.

new.text: click a player to see their ranks and stats beside the board, with Player of the Month shown by default.
you can paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V when writing a support request or reply.
teams can choose Europe as their country.
organizers can add a Twitch channel, shown as a Twitch button on the tournament page once it starts.
new articles can be announced automatically in the DEAFCS Discord.
a Connect button joins a public server in one click, on the Public Servers page and on Play.
staff can show a Twitch channel as the match's main broadcast or as a Twitch button in the match bar.

improved.text: Community Polls are now at the top of the News page.
players live on Twitch are now shown on the Watch page.
patch notes are grouped into fewer, clearer sections.
when you are signed in, DEAFCS opens on your profile stats.
the Last 7 Days records are now on the Leaderboard, under Player of the Month.
Your Schedule on Play now shows your later matches, solo and free-agent sign-ups, and a Show more button.
Twitch channels are now linked by signing in with Twitch, so only the real owner can add one.
the stream delay notice before linking Twitch is now shorter and easier to read.
public servers are shown as compact rows with a map picture, mode, Full status and player count, on the Public Servers page and on Play.
warnings now expire after 21 days. Old warnings stay in the history.
the Public Servers page is back to the large server cards, sorted by players.
Connect explains how to join with the CS2 console if the game does not open, with a Copy button.
live match cards count each stream once.
players streaming their live DEAFCS match show on Watch whatever they stream.

fixed.text: Your Schedule on Play now shows your tournament check-in status instead of always saying Registered.
sections on the Watch and Play pages are separated by a thin line again.
only administrators get direct GOTV access; streamers and tournament organizers broadcast delayed TV within their matches.

new.text: The Leaderboard has an Award Catalog tab with every award and who holds it.
A new answer explains how your stats are worked out and links to the Stats Guide.
In Captain Pick, hovering a player shows their last 30 matches and ratings.
the menu shows how many players are on the public servers.
a Min. matches slider hides players with too few matches from the stats boards.

improved.text: The left menu is cleaner, with compact rows, a bigger logo and an unread count on News.
The party in the top bar is a compact pill with your party size, privacy and a member menu.
The Create Lobby button is smaller and rounder.
Steam game-ban details are now only visible to administrators.

fixed.text: The page you are on is now clearly highlighted in the menu.
Very active players now see all of their recent matches in their stats.
Player search finds offline and online players when Online is off.
DEAFCS Pro matches now show the Pro badge in match lists and on profiles.
the webcam button in Your Squad now matches the other buttons.
returning to a DEAFCS tab left open in the background no longer reloads every chat.
the match page no longer jumps down when the map veto appears.
pages no longer jump sideways as they finish loading.

new.text: Teams can pick a country, shown as a flag beside the team name on team pages, match pages and tournament team lists.
organizers can choose Random or By ELO seeding and whether check-in needs an admin review.
Organizers can set Freeze Time next to Round Restart Delay.
organizers can seed a tournament by team ELO instead of at random.
organizers choose whether check-in needs an admin review; without it the bracket is drawn automatically from the teams that checked in.
Global search finds teams as well as players.

improved.text: Restart Map now warns that recorded rounds will be set aside.
Only staff can restore rounds or restart a map from the match page.
the Teams tab shows each team's seed and, before the draw, its projected seed and first opponent.
seed numbers stay with teams across the bracket, standings and match page, and hovering a team highlights its route.
Check-in Review explains when a tournament is held for too few teams and what the organizer can do.
when several tournaments are live, each gets its own tab on the Tournaments page.
during check-in the panel shows how many teams have checked in, with a link to the Teams tab.
deleting a tournament first shows its played matches, demos, clips, rated matches and awards, and asks you to confirm.
AIM Rules is replaced by the Freeze Time and Round Restart Delay settings.
a tournament with too few eligible teams after check-in now waits for its organizers instead of being cancelled, and admins are told.
deleting a tournament first shows its played matches, demos, clips, rated matches and awards, and needs them confirmed.
The bracket's Fit button now switches between fitting the bracket and 100% zoom.
The tournament chat no longer shows a webcam room button.
DEAFCS Pro starts searching right away, without an extra language popup.
Webhook addresses are hidden until you press the eye icon.
Times older than an hour show the exact date and time, including in notifications.
The DEAFCS Pro popup simply says "Only English language".
Opening and closing the left sidebar is smoother, also with the chat open.

fixed.text: Only the team owner can hand over a team, and the owner can no longer be removed or demoted by others.
The match filters on player profiles fit on one line on more screen sizes.
The Save button in the team editor is fully visible again on every screen size.
Restoring a round no longer counts kills and damage from the interrupted round twice.
stages always play the tournament's map pool, and match type and map pool lock once the bracket is drawn.
the Team Owner picker shows the player's flag and name, and Save stays visible in the Team Editor.
a stage with its own settings now keeps the tournament's camera, auto-cancel and server settings, and a refused save no longer saves half of the tournament settings.
the Check-in Review page shows its headings and labels instead of raw text keys.
Check-in Review shows the full date and time each team registered.
Registration counts on tournament cards now show the players actually on each team.
a tournament's map pool now always reaches its stages and matches, and it can't change once the bracket is drawn.
an expired tournament match is no longer always awarded to the first team; it goes against the team that didn't show up, or to an admin.
a tournament that ends before its final has no podium instead of a wrong one, and a final won by a bye gets the right medals.
a match whose maps all end level now ends as a tie instead of staying live.
The Round Restart Delay organizers choose now applies in matches.
Opening registration for an invite-only tournament no longer notifies every player.
The Teams tab count now matches the teams shown after check-in, and seeds no longer appear twice.
Open Twitch Widget goes to the new widget address.
Opening the left sidebar no longer cuts off labels or pushes buttons outside it.

new.text: Season awards show their season and game mode.
You get a notification when you receive a season medal.
Lineups you save on your practice server now appear right away in a This Server group at the top of Mine, numbered in save order.
A Utility tab shows every grenade on CT and T maps, checked against the common lineups, with Watch and Save.
Lineups with saved bots show a badge on the map, and each bot's spot when you open the lineup.

improved.text: The Awards board now ranks players by Gold, then Silver, Bronze, MVP and Special.
Stat tables can now be sorted with the keyboard and announce their sort order to screen readers.
Live streams stay closer to real time when they fall behind.

fixed.text: A player's Awards rank now matches their place on the board.
Refreshing the page no longer loses your place in a friend's practice server.
Audio stays in sync with the picture on long live streams.
A clip's thumbnail is now saved before the clip is finished, so fewer clips appear without one.

new.text: DEAFCS Pro is a scheduled solo 5v5 queue with Captain Pick for top-ranked players.

improved.text: Cancelling a tournament or resetting it to Setup now asks for confirmation first.
Each mode shows its map pool when you hover or tap its info icon.
The Play page shows Competitive, Wingman and Duel in a cleaner layout on every screen size.
Maps a Grand Final did not need are muted and marked Not needed.
Administrators can delete a tournament with rated matches without voiding ELO first.
Organizers can reset or change a match winner without voiding ELO first.

fixed.text: Organizers can cancel a match that already has a demo.
Canceled matches no longer count toward player statistics or leaderboards.
A canceled match keeps its played maps, rounds and stats, even before its demo arrives.
Changing an earlier result no longer swaps the teams of a canceled match that was already played.
A tournament can no longer be cancelled or deleted while its matches are being played.
A match started again right after a cancel keeps its server.
A canceled match that is started again replays the unfinished map from warmup and keeps its finished maps.
A tournament with played matches can no longer be reset to Setup.
Organizers can recover an unfinished series without awarding a win, and resetting a match keeps its finished maps.
Correcting the winner of a final now finishes the tournament again.
The Grand Final uses its own best-of and map advantage at any bracket size.
The match page shows the upper bracket team's Grand Final map advantage.
The bracket and match lists show a Grand Final's full series score, including the upper bracket advantage.
Setting a map winner in a Grand Final counts the upper bracket team's map advantage.

new.text: Competitive ELO now depends mostly on the result and the strength of both teams.
Your match rating counts for up to 10% of your Competitive ELO change.

improved.text: Competitive gains and losses get smaller above 10,000 ELO, about ±50 at 20,000.
Competitive ELO can't drop below 1,000.
Leaving a Competitive, Wingman or Duel match now gives 50% of the gain if your team wins, or twice the loss if your team loses.
In Duel and Wingman, wins against the same opponent are worth less after three meetings in 7 days. Losses aren't affected.
The ELO popup explains leaver and repeat opponent adjustments.
Your current ELO and past matches stay as they are. The new rules apply to matches that start from now on.

new.text: Organizers can turn on AIM Rules for a Duel tournament: 3 second freeze time, free Kevlar, no buy time and a 3 second delay between rounds.

improved.text: The left sidebar has clearer groups, with Community, Updates and Info sections.
The Info section stays open or closed after a page reload, like the other sections.
General, Matchmaking and Tournament Rules are now one Rules page with three tabs.
The Info section is shorter, and the collapsed sidebar shows it as one icon with a menu.

new.text: Report a player from their row on the scoreboard or the "..." menu next to their name, in a popup with a reason, the map and the round.
The scoreboard shows each player's CS2 teammate color.
Organizers can turn ELO off for a tournament in its settings, before the first match starts.
Verified players can open Public Servers in the Practice section, and each server card can show its own picture.
Share on a clip opens Copy link and Download, and a clip's owner and staff can delete it right from the tile.

improved.text: The Contact page shows with pictures how to call support in a match and how to report a player.
Call for Support now explains where to report a player instead.
Each day's patch notes are grouped by section, with a New, Improved or Fixed tag on every change.
Match page highlight clips load with less work for the site.
The Public Servers page and the Play page's server card load with less work for the site.
Leaderboards show fades and buttons on edges with more columns to scroll to.
Player profiles load with less work for the site and show changes made elsewhere on your next visit.

fixed.text: Regions with only public servers (Deathmatch, Retake) no longer show up in matchmaking, so you can't queue where no match server can start.
Match logs, system logs and RCON command suggestions show player names and plugin text as plain text.
Removing a category from a tournament works again.
Free-agent-only tournaments offer "Join as a free agent" instead of "Register" on their cards.
A deleted clip leaves every list and playlist without a reload.
Deleting the first clip of a match group shows the next clip right away instead of the deleted one.
Only a clip's creator and staff can change or delete it, and only its creator can rename it.

improved.text: Match pages open faster, and the scoreboard keeps players in a steady ADR order during live matches.

fixed.text: Older player reports show the reported player's profile link again.
Team kills, suicides and assists on teammates no longer count toward your kills, assists and weapon stats.
Kill and K/D boards no longer count team kills or suicides as kills.
Stats tabs and the standings tiebreaker count kills and deaths the same way as everywhere else.

days.title: Patch Notes | November 1, 2026
days.summary: Team history on profiles and team pages, a new Changelog page, a new search, and matchmaking by region.

new.text: Player profiles now show current and previous teams, with available membership history.
Team pages show a roster history of current and former members.
The team activity feed shows when players join, rejoin, leave or are removed.
A new Changelog page under Info shows patch notes by day, with search, filters and a dot for new changes.
EU and SA are now separate region groups, and the Play page counts the queue for your region group.
Press Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on Mac) or use Search in the left menu to find pages, players, FAQ answers and your settings.

improved.text: Each region group can open or close matchmaking modes on its own, and the Play page shows what is open in your region.
If a mode closes while you are in its queue, you leave the queue and get a message.
Choose EU or SA from a dropdown in settings or on your profile. Staff approve the change.
Your notifications, friends and My Matches appear sooner when a page opens.
The Teams page, league seasons, tournament bracket previews and the utility library stay quick when many people view them at once.
The scoreboard keeps players in ADR order in every view, rows move smoothly when their positions change, and stat numbers roll like an odometer.
The team page tabs are one full-width bar under the team header, with the active tab highlighted, and it stays on screen while you scroll.
K/D, HS% and rating boards filtered by source or role load much faster.
Report details no longer show an empty profile row.

fixed.text: Stream and demo startup progress now shows the workshop map download in the right order.
When a mode is closed, a ready check that fails no longer puts you back in its queue or starts a new one.
A clip you make private leaves the public Highlights and Watch lists right away.
Team cards show a space before "vs" in the Next and Last rows.
After your role changes, the site picks up your new permissions right away without a reload.
A late duplicate status from a game server no longer ends the next map early or loses a map's result.
Steam messages that Steam delays or rate-limits are retried instead of lost, and are never sent twice.
Rebuilding a season's ratings now keeps its tournament matches, so season ELO stays correct.
Report a Player opens 5 minutes after the match ends, and the match page shows the time left.
Player names show correctly when choosing who to report.
